archetypes.name: dyn-oos-gate
archetypes.rationale: OOS filing now depends on a derived vote/severity gate across multiple sinks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed OOS filing gates in code review, design review, emit-tally rebuilds, and aggregate-pool promotion. Check that accepted but non-fileable OOS cannot enter accepted sinks, aggregate pools, or issue filing paths. Pay special attention to Fileable=true marker parsing and main-agent or serialized rebuild paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
